image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a man sitting in the rear-facing jump seat of a green golf cart. The man is wearing sunglasses and a black t-shirt, leaning forward with his arms resting on the silver metal roll bar/frame. The background shows a grassy area with other parked vehicles (RVs/campers) and people, suggesting a campground or event setting.
